subject: SOC2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — dual-channel handoff proposal and times
thread_content:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — dual-channel handoff proposal and times

Hi Bethany —

Thanks for the quick intake last week. To keep this short: we'd like to propose a two-part approach so we can meet Acme Financial's compliance needs without packing too much into one call. Options and asks below.

Proposed plan (suggested):
- Session A (SOC 2 + DPA review): 60 minutes — evidence mapping, architecture diagram, attestation questions.
- Session B (Pen-test logistics + scope summary): 30–45 minutes — pen vendor handshake, IP allowlist, test windows.

Scheduling options (all times shown with Redwood PST):
- Wed, Nov 26: 16:00 UTC / 08:00 PST (early APAC-friendly)
- Thu, Nov 27: 09:00 PST (mid-morning US) — our preference
- Fri, Nov 28: 08:00 PST — alternative if you want a follow-up next day

Logistics / asks for the call:
1) Please confirm whether you want both sessions consolidated (90 min) or split (we recommend split).
2) List of attendees from your side (security, legal, procurement).
3) If pen test will require allowlisting, please share expected public IP ranges — we can provide Redwood's port/IP details.
4) I attached a short preflight bundle (SOC2_Preflight.pdf) and a Network_Diagram.png for context.

We can run the call as a dual-channel handoff: Zoom + an ops bridge (phone) so our ops/pen team can flip to the pen-test channel if needed. Camila can run the bridge.

If Thu Nov 27 09:00 PST works, I'll send invites for Session A and a provisional Session B.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

---
From: Bethany Cole <bethany.cole@acmefinancial.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: James Williams <j.williams@acmefinancial.com>, Acme Financial Security Team <security@acmefinancial.com>
Date: 2025-11-20T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — dual-channel handoff proposal and times

Rishi —

Appreciate the options. We prefer splitting the sessions to keep the pen-test discussion tight. Proposed from our side:
- Session A (SOC2 + DPA): Thu, Nov 27 at 16:00 UTC (09:00 PST) — fine for our security and legal leads.
- Session B (Pen-test logistics): Fri, Nov 28 at 15:00 UTC (08:00 PST) — prefer a short follow-up.

Attendees: Bethany Cole (sec lead), James Williams (IT ops), Maria Fernandez (legal) — I looped James.

We also have a short scope doc attached (Acme_Security_Scope.docx). Regarding allowlist: we typically provide our vendor a list of allowed CIDRs in advance. Could you send Redwood's public endpoints/IPs and a contact for the ops bridge?

Also: we need to review the DPA redlines before the walkthrough — is there a DocuSign or shared link for that?

Thanks,
Bethany
Head of Security
Acme Financial

Rishi / Ben —

I can lead Session A (SOC2 + DPA). Ben should lead Session B (pen-test logistics). Camila will stand up the ops bridge and handle recording/notes.

Prep checklist I'll pull together and share before the call:
- Evidence index (short CSV) — what we'll present and where it's stored
- Architecture diagram (we already have Network_Diagram.png in the thread)
- Roles map (who answers which attestation/questions)

Quick notes:
- Recommend we ask Acme if they'd like a separate vendor-only bridge during pen-test handshake (keeps blast radius small).
- We should provide IP ranges and ports to be allowlisted at least 48 hours before Session B.
- If they need an after-hours slot (nightshift exception) for APAC, we can accommodate — but prefer Thu 09:00 PST for Session A.

I'll draft the meeting invite text (objectives + pre-reads) and share.

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
